description:
Redirect any Windows/MacOS TCP and UDP traffic to HTTP/Socks5 proxy

ProxyBridge is a lightweight, open-source universal proxy client (Proxifier alternative) that provides transparent proxy routing for applications on Windows and macOS. It redirects TCP and UDP traffic from specific processes through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies, with the ability to route, block, or allow traffic on a per-application basis. ProxyBridge fully supports both TCP and UDP proxy routing and works at the system level, making it compatible with proxy-unaware applications without requiring any configuration changes.
ProxyBridge v4.1.1 (Windows)
🔒 Security Update
ProxyBridge's engine runs as a Windows service, so the app itself no longer needs administrator rights. This release tightens who can talk to that service and what it runs.
- Only authorised users can control the service. - Service IPC now validate the communication with the authorised users group
- Protected install folder. The installer now locks the install folder so only SYSTEM and Administrators can modify it.
- The app verifies it is talking to the real service. The app now checks that the other end of its connection is the genuine ProxyBridge service before sending anything.
- Safer DLL loading. The GUI and CLI load the engine only from their own install folder, never from the current directory or PATH.
